headline: A Tale of Tinted Courts Residence / Architects Collaborative
context: In a quaint residential neighborhood in Noida , the project is a single-family home on a convenient 300 sq.m. plot. With a South-West facing orientation, the house looks directly into the small park it faces, allowing a fair framing of the greens directly in front.
